name: Reboot Addons
author: Miguel Carneiro

sections.description:
Reboot Addons gives Elementor a curated set of widgets and site tools that were built the way we build them for real client sites: fast, focused and without the bloat. Every control lives where you expect it in the Elementor panel, every feature works in the free version, and nothing is loaded that you didn’t switch on.

Carousels that actually look designed.
* 3D Carousel : a perspective image carousel with real depth and reflections, perfect for portfolios, products and hero sections.
* 3D Vertical Carousel : the same striking effect, rotated for a vertical scroll-worthy layout.
* Card Slider : swipeable image-and-text cards with built-in navigation dots for custom content or posts.

Styling tools for everyday sections.
* Reboot Menu : a flexible, fully styleable navigation menu for headers and footers, complete with off canvas and full page menu options for mobile.
* Business Hours : a clean opening-hours table with highlighted weekend rows and ready-made color schemes, ideal for local businesses.
* Content Fade Reveal : reveal content with smooth fade-in animation for images as visitors scroll the text, keeping pages alive without hurting load times.
* Elementor Back Button : a reliable back button and link widget for better on-page navigation.

Six Form Styler widgets, zero CSS.
Ready-made preset themes plus full visual control over colors, borders, radius, shadows and typography for Gravity Forms, Contact Form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms, SureForms and Forminator. Pick a free preset, tweak it live in the Elementor editor or create your own from scratch .

Login Stylizer — a wp-login.php your brand deserves.
Design your entire WordPress login screen visually with a live preview: logo, form background with blur and opacity, full-page background (color, gradient, image or video) with overlay, inputs, labels, submit button, animations, footer text and social links. Five starter presets get you going in seconds, with optional reCAPTCHA v2/v3, remember-me defaults and login redirects built in.

Features & Tweaks — performance and polish with one click.
Trim .00 decimals from prices, replace the WooCommerce archive Add to Cart with a custom button link that goes straight to the product page, disable cart fragments, remove emoji scripts, XML-RPC and the version number, hide the admin bar for non-admins and more. Small toggles, measurable speed and cleaner sites.

Reboot Addons Pro (optional) adds 15 more widgets (Animated Side Menu, Glow Cards, App Menu, Advanced Text FX and more), 20 extra Login Stylizer themes, JSON import/export for login designs and 13 extra tweaks. See the “Go Pro” page in the plugin menu or https://rebootwebsites.co.za/reboot-addons/. The free version is fully functional on its own — Pro simply adds more.

Missing a widget you need? Tell us what would make your next project easier — we build based on user requests.

External services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services:

Google reCAPTCHA (optional, disabled by default)
Used by the Login Stylizer to add a reCAPTCHA challenge to your login form. If you enable it and enter your own site key and secret key, the login page loads Google’s reCAPTCHA script and, on submission, your server sends the response token to Google for verification along with the visitor’s IP address. No data is sent if reCAPTCHA is not enabled.
Terms of use: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Fonts (optional)
If you select a custom font in the Login Stylizer, the font’s stylesheet is loaded from Google’s Fonts CDN so the login screen matches your branding. Only the font family name you chose is requested; the visitor’s browser contacts Google directly to download it. No data is sent if you keep the default font.
Terms of use: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload reboot-addons to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins > Add New
  2. Activate through Plugins menu
  3. Go to Reboot Addons > Login Stylizer or Reboot Addons > Features to configure
  4. Open any page with Elementor — find Reboot categories in the widget panel
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. Works with free Elementor. Some widgets replace Pro features (e.g., form styler) but Pro can stay active.

Will this work with any theme?

Yes. Tested with Hello Elementor and block themes.

Does a premium version exist?

Yes — Reboot Addons Pro adds 15 more widgets (Animated Side Menu, Glow Cards, App Menu, Advanced Text FX, Advanced Image FX and more), 20 extra Login Stylizer themes, JSON import/export for login designs, and 13 extra WooCommerce/WordPress/Elementor tweaks. See the “Go Pro” page in the plugin menu or https://rebootwebsites.co.za/reboot-addons/. The free version is fully functional on its own.

Where are the presets?

Reboot Addons > Login Stylizer > Presets dropdown — 5 starter presets included. Each Form Styler (e.g., WPForms, Gravity Forms) has its own preset dropdown in the Elementor panel.

How do I update?

Via WordPress Updates.
sections.changelog:
1.1.8

  • First release on the WordPress.org directory.
  • Fix: explicit sanitize callbacks registered for widget toggle settings.
  • Content Fade Reveal rewritten as a dependency-free vanilla JS engine (100% GPL).

1.1.7

  • The plugin now deactivates itself gracefully with a notice on WordPress versions older than 6.4, instead of erroring.

1.1.0

  • WordPress.org-ready release: the free version is fully functional with no locked features, all presets included, external assets bundled locally, and the text domain aligned with the plugin slug.
